Bill.BriefDescription: Extending the life of frequent ferry user coupons.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to frequent user coupons for the state ferrysystem; adding a new section to chapter 47.60 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that: (1) Frequent users of the state's ferry system often purchasefrequent user coupons. Currently, coupon books have an expiration dateof ninety days after the date of purchase; (2) Ferry fares have been raised considerably over the last year;and (3) Citizens who cannot use all of their frequent user coupons losesignificant money each year.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Frequent user coupons for the Washington state ferry system arevalid for one year from the date of purchase, after which time the p. 1 SB 5292tickets will not be accepted for passage. Unused coupons are eligiblefor refund up to one year from the date of purchase.
